title: IncrementalClassificationECOC Predict
text: Classify observations using incremental ECOC classification model, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Binary learner loss function} sets Binary learner loss function; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental classification ECOC model, {Add output port for predicted class scores} adds second output port, {Add output port for positive-class scores of binary learners} adds third output port, {Decoding scheme}, {Predictor data observation dimension} sets the observation dimension of predictor data, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Label data type} sets the data type of label output, {Label data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of label output for range checking, {Label data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of label output for range checking, {Score data type} sets the data type of score output Inherit, {Score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of score output for range checking, {Score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of score output for range checking, {Positive-class score data type}, {Positive-class score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of pbscore output for range checking, {Positive-class score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of pbscore output for range checking, {Binary learner score data type}, {Binary learner score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of binary learner score for range checking, {Binary learner score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of binary learner score for range checking, {Binary learner kernel data type} sets the binary learner kernel computation data type, {Binary learner kernel data type Minimum} sets the minimum kernel computation value for range checking and {Binary learner kernel data type Maximum} sets the maximum kernel computation value for range checking. Values come from the instance.
